tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The issue involves differential customs duty on Denatured Ethyl Alcohol imported by the Company. A writ petition has been filed by Company before High Court of Gujarat to challenge the same. Further, during the pendency of this writ petition, a Show Cause Notice dated 28.06.2022 was issued by Customs, Ludhiana to explain why should a duty short paid of Rs 10.95 Crore not be demanded by denying the concessional duty. The Company also submits its detailed reply to the said SCN.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: UNION OF INDIA & ORS. / COMMISSIONER OF CUSTOMS, LUDHIANA, PUNJAB
tax_litigation.status: Pending for adjudication before Honrable High Court Gujarat. However, the Court vide an interim Order dated 17-10-2024 ordered that during the pendency of this petition, while the proceedings pursuant to the Show-cause notice may continue, no final order shall be passed by the respondent - the Customs Department without permission of this Court.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The Company has received an Order-In-Original (O-I-O) confirming demand of differential Customs duty of Rs.27,97,398/-, along with interest, penalty of Rs. 27,97,398/- under Section 114A of the Customs Act, 1962, additional penalty of Rs. 100,00,000/- under section 114AA of Customs Act, 1962 along with redemption fine of Rs. 50,00,000/- aggregating to Rs.2,05,94,796/- alleging incorrectly availed ASEAN-India FTA exemption by using Certificates of Origin not conforming to the prescribed format under Notification No. 46/2011-Customs read with ASEAN-India FTA Rules of Origin.
tax_litigation.status: The Company has filed an appeal under Section 128 of the Customs Act, 1962 before the Commissioner (Appeals), Ahmedabad against Order-in-Original No. KDL/ADC/MR/13/2026-27 dated 08.05.2026 passed by the Additional Commissioner of Customs, Kandla. The appeal has been registered as Appeal No. 28/CUS/KDL/JUNE/2026-27 dated 18.06.2026 and is currently pending for adjudication before the Commissioner (Appeals), Ahmedabad.
